# JPEG XR reader fixture

`rgb.ppm` is an original deterministic 16×16 RGB gradient:
`R = 13*x`, `G = 11*y`, `B = 7*(x+y)`. It is covered by the repository license.
`rgb.jxr` was encoded losslessly from those pixels using the external ITU-T
T.835 (2012) software 1.32; no reference source or conformance vector is vendored.

Regenerate with the reference executable built by the sibling JXR workspace:

```sh
../jxr/target/t835-oracle/t835-201201/Software/jpegxr \
  -c -q 0 -l 0 -f YUV444 -o tests/fixtures/jxr/rgb.jxr tests/fixtures/jxr/rgb.ppm
```

Tests embed the same compressed payload in synthetic CZI and tiled TIFF
containers, then compare exact decoded pixels, including TIFF edge cropping.

`rgb.czi` is generated by `fuzz/seeds/generate.py::czi_jpegxr` from that same
JPEG XR payload. The `open_wsi_bytes/czi-jpegxr.czi` fuzz seed prepends the CZI
extension selector. Its integration test verifies that the generated container
opens and produces the original pixels.
